# 1 Clement Chapter 49 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 49 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_049_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 49

*[A hymn to love — echoing 1 Corinthians 13]*

**49:1** Let the one who has love in Christ keep the commandments of Christ.

**49:2** Who can describe the bond of the love of God? Who is capable of expressing the greatness of its beauty?

**49:3** The height to which love leads up is inexpressible.

**49:4** Love unites us to God; love covers a multitude of sins; love endures all things, is long-suffering in all things; there is nothing base in love, nothing arrogant; love has no schism, love does not rebel, love does all things in concord; in love were all the chosen of God made perfect; without love nothing is well-pleasing to God.

**49:5** In love the Master took us to himself; because of the love he had toward us, Jesus Christ our Lord gave his blood for us by the will of God — his flesh for our flesh, his life for our lives.

**49:6** You see, beloved, how great and wonderful is love, and of its perfection there is no speaking.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
